headline: Tax minister plans deposit scheme to stop interest outgrowing tax claims
headline_short: Deposit scheme planned for tax disputes
deck: In one case a 158 million kroner claim ended with 362 million kroner in interest.
standard: Taxpayers will be able to deposit the disputed amount during a tax case, so interest cannot outgrow the claim itself, under a scheme in next year's budget, Jakob Engel-Schmidt, the tax and growth minister, says in a statement.

The ministry cites a case from January 2023 in which a company first owed 158 million kroner and ended up facing 362 million kroner in interest. Engel-Schmidt calls it 'completely unreasonable' that the state can pursue a case through the courts for years while interest keeps running.
The state earns 70 million kroner a year from such interest; a tax expert quoted by Berlingske calls the plan 'excellent'.
short: Taxpayers will be able to deposit the disputed amount during a tax case, so interest cannot outgrow the claim, under a scheme in next year's budget, Jakob Engel-Schmidt, the tax and growth minister, says.
